_about: Every player-facing line Claude adds or rewords in Landlordsector (Andrzej, 2026-11-16). text_review.py builds text.html from this list. id: the review page's key, never reused. version: the release that added or changed it. Example values in the line are shown as they appear in game.

lines.line: Commute: +32 from proximity to city center
lines.when: First line of the Commute tooltip on a home sheet (agent's screen and Real estate tab). The number is the home's own spot, 0 (outskirts) to 50. Homes next to the city center always show +50.
Title of the Upgrades row's tooltip on a home sheet. Below it, what all the built upgrades do together.

lines.line: Jana Okoye threw a party at Leafy Cottage. It left a few scuffs.
lines.when: Housewarming tenant event, in the home's log (the home loses 1% condition).

lines.line: A service you hired is no longer offered and was cancelled.
lines.when: Home log, once, when you load a save where that home had the Night watchman.

lines.line: Not long now. The baby kicks all night.
lines.when: Your partner greets you when you open their comm link, while a baby is on the way.
Your partner greets you when you open their comm link, while a baby is on the way (the other of two picked at random).

lines.line: Look who finally remembered where they live.
lines.when: Your partner greets you when you open their comm link, when you have not visited in a long time.

lines.line: Oh, you're alive. Good to know.
lines.when: Your partner greets you when you open their comm link, when you have not visited in a long time (other pick).
Your partner greets you when you open their comm link, when their happiness is below 25.
Your partner greets you when you open their comm link, when their happiness is below 25 (other pick).

lines.line: There you are. I missed you.
lines.when: Your partner greets you when you open their comm link: your wife or husband, happiness 60 or more.
Your partner greets you when you open their comm link: your wife or husband, happiness 60 or more (other pick).
Your partner greets you when you open their comm link, any other time.
Your partner greets you when you open their comm link, any other time (other pick).
Option in your partner's comm link.

lines.line: A child is already on the way.
lines.when: Tooltip on "Let's try for a child." when a baby is on the way (the option is greyed out).
Tooltip on "Let's try for a child." when you already tried today.
Option in your partner's comm link. Opens a cargo picker for a gift.
Tooltip on "I got you something." when your cargo holds nothing they would take.

lines.line: I think we should break up.
lines.when: Option in your partner's comm link, when you are not married.
Option in your partner's comm link, when you are married.
Their answer when you click Propose and they say yes, in the message at the top of the Real estate tab (see the full message below).

lines.line: I thought you'd never ask. Yes!
lines.when: The same answer, other pick.

lines.line: Mira Okoye is now your wife.
lines.when: After they say yes: in that message and in the home's log. "husband" for a man.
Their answer in the rare (2%) case they turn you down. They stay in your service and never say yes.
Your partner's answer to "Let's try for a child." (one of three outcomes).

lines.line: We already have one on the way, remember?
lines.when: Your partner's answer to "Let's try for a child." (one of three outcomes).
Dialog text after "Let's try for a child." (one of three outcomes).
Title of the cargo picker after "I got you something." Buttons: Give, Cancel.
Side text of the gift picker: the value of what you picked.

lines.line: A nanoforge? Where am I supposed to put a nanoforge?
lines.when: Your partner's reaction when the gift is a nanoforge.

lines.line: A fusion lamp. For the living room. Sure.
lines.when: Your partner's reaction when the gift is an Orbital Fusion Lamp.

lines.line: What does it do? No, don't tell me.
lines.when: Your partner's reaction when the gift is a Synchrotron Core.
Your partner's reaction when the gift is Soil Nanites.

lines.line: It's so cold. Why is it so cold?
lines.when: Your partner's reaction when the gift is a Cryoarithmetic Engine.

lines.line: It's humming. Should it be humming?
lines.when: Your partner's reaction when the gift is a Coronal Hypershunt Tap.

lines.line: You want me to drill a hole in the planet?
lines.when: Your partner's reaction when the gift is a Mantle Bore.
Your partner's reaction when the gift is a Biofactory Embryo.

lines.line: It's making more of itself. Make it stop.
lines.when: Your partner's reaction when the gift is a Drone Replicator.

lines.line: Finally, something for the living room.
lines.when: Your partner's reaction when the gift is a Dealmaker Holosuite.
Your partner's reaction when the gift is a Fullerene Spool.
Your partner's reaction when the gift is a Plasma Dynamo.
Your partner's reaction when the gift is a Catalytic Core.
Reaction to any other gift worth under 20,000 credits.
Reaction to any other gift worth 20,000 to 200,000 credits.

lines.line: Do you know what this is worth? I know exactly what to do with it.
lines.when: Reaction to any other gift worth 200,000 to 1,000,000 credits.

lines.line: Are you out of your mind? This could buy a moon!
lines.when: Reaction to any other gift worth 1,000,000 credits or more.

lines.line: She sells it for 120,000 credits and has Air conditioning and a Pool built, then has the house repaired. She keeps the rest: 8,000 credits.
lines.when: Dialog text after a gift: what your partner did with the money (parts left out when they don't apply).
Option after "I think we should break up." or "I want a divorce."
Option after "I think we should break up." or "I want a divorce." Goes back.

lines.line: The house is sold and you get half. The kids go with her.
lines.when: Tooltip on "Yes. It's over." when you are married.
Tooltip on "Yes. It's over." when you are not married and have kids with them.

lines.line: Fine. My lawyer will call you.
lines.when: Their answer when you divorce them.
Their answer when you break up (not married).

lines.line: You broke up with Mira Okoye. She took the kids with her.
lines.when: Dialog, home log and intel after a break-up (the kids part only if any).

lines.line: You and Mira Okoye are divorced. She took the kids with her. Leafy Cottage was sold. Your half: 210,000 credits.
lines.when: Dialog and intel message after a divorce.

lines.line: Mira Okoye left you: Leafy Cottage is falling apart.

lines.line: Mira Okoye divorced you. She got tired of waiting for you to come home.

Home log and intel when a baby is on the way (partner is a woman).

lines.when: Home log and intel when the baby is born (partner is a woman).

lines.line: You had a daughter with Ivan Reyes: Lena.
lines.when: Home log and intel when the baby is born (you are a woman).
Home log and intel when a child grows up (after the LunaLib cycles).

lines.line: Tomas grabs at the screen and giggles.
lines.when: Your child greets you when you open their comm link, under 1 cycle old.
Your child greets you when you open their comm link: grown up and has not picked what to be. "Mom" if you are a woman.

lines.line: Dad! When can we take the Kite out again?
lines.when: Your child greets you when you open their comm link: wants to be an officer.

lines.line: Dad, did you know a gamma core can run a whole farm?
lines.when: Your child greets you when you open their comm link: wants to be an administrator.

lines.line: I dug all the way down to bedrock today!
lines.when: Your child greets you when you open their comm link: wants to be a miner.

lines.line: I've been practicing my spy walk. Watch.
lines.when: Your child greets you when you open their comm link: wants to be an agent.

lines.line: Everyone at school says I'm the prettiest.
lines.when: Your child greets you when you open their comm link: wants to be a local celebrity.
Your child greets you when you open their comm link, any other time.

lines.line: Let's pick a new name for you.
lines.when: Option in your child's comm link. Opens a box titled "New name".

lines.line: Wanna go for a drive in the Kite I bought, son?
lines.when: Option in your child's comm link: pushes them toward being an officer. "daughter" for a girl.

lines.line: I see you're reading "AI Cores in Industry"?
lines.when: Option in your child's comm link: toward being an administrator.
Option in your child's comm link: toward being a miner.

lines.line: That 007 movie is pretty cool, eh?
lines.when: Option in your child's comm link: toward being an agent. Only with Nexerelin.
Option in your child's comm link: toward being a local celebrity (colony growth).
Answer to any of those options from a baby under 1 cycle old.

lines.line: Yes! Can I fly it this time?
lines.when: Your child's answer to the officer option.

lines.line: It's really good. I want to run a colony one day.

lines.line: I'm going to dig the biggest mine ever.
lines.when: Your child's answer to the miner option.

lines.line: I want to be a spy when I grow up.

Your child's answer to the celebrity option.
Dialog text when a grown-up child picks a path and starts it at once.
